question: Which two firmware packages are included in the Cisco UCS C-Series Rack-Mount UCS-Managed Server Software bundle? (Choose two.)
theory: The C-Series Rack-Mount UCS-Managed Server Software bundle carries the firmware images that a C-Series server's own hardware components need — including CIMC and BIOS firmware (as well as board controller and adapter images) — mirroring the same logic used for the B-Series bundle but targeted at rack servers instead of blades. PSU, system, and third-party firmware are not distinct entries delivered through this UCS-Managed server bundle, which is why CIMC and BIOS are the two correct selections. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Bundles, C-Series Software Bundle)
